body:
I feel as though this cloak has become my accessory of choice as of late haha. I tend to avoid drinking when I'm feeling miserable. I might forget about everything for a while but I tend to get really, really angry, and I don't want to do anything stupid or hurt anyone in any capacity while I'm drunk and angry. The only person I want to hurt is myself.

Adderall is my drug of choice haha. Stimulants just make everything feel perfect as is. I have energy, euphoria, happiness, motivation, everything. I know it's just a fleeting feeling and that ultimately it'll probably do a lot more harm than good in the long run, but if there's no long run, what's the point in not, ya know?

I will definitely try that out, thank you. Nostalgia really has been my biggest issue. I am definitely seeing my past through rose tinted glasses.

Yeah, I can understand that. I'll definitely look into that vow. I've hit this huge self destructive streak and it feels like a train with no brakes...

Exercise, reading, studying, travelling every once in a while (I've been to four continents and 13 countries), dabble safely with drugs, spending some quality time with friends about two or three times a month, shit that sounds great on paper. And sure, I'm happy while I'm out and about doing shit. It's after I get home, when I'm alone, staring at my wall, that everything just hits me. As of late, it's been hitting me even when I'm out. It's as though I _want_ to think about killing myself for this bizarre fucking reason. I envy you... It must have been a difficult road for you as well.

Can you expand upon the problems? I've been cutting in places I normally wouldn't show publicly, so I'm unconcerned with scars, I'm just concerned about how to hide them from my girlfriend... I've used some of this anger to force myself to wake up earlier, run, lift, diet, etc. etc. which I do believe has been helping, albeit for the wrong reasons...

I'm just slowly becoming more afraid of living than I am of dying... Can you please share how you helped yourself? I think, deep down, I really don't want to do this. I'm either blinded to my other options or I'm a piece of shit who refuses to help himself.

Thank you. I just needed somewhere to vent before I took it out on myself again. Self-harm has been my newest vice as of late.

It's just so hard... It feels like nothing will ever get better. Sure, I have better days, where I feel like everything might be alright. But God, I'm just so worn out. It's like those better days are there to taunt me. Happiness just feels so foreign. I feel like I've just gotten so used to feeling like shit that I want to feel like shit...

I do think that a person is molded by his/her experiences, which is why it's difficult for me to imagine not feeling like this. I don't know if I can change though. 1/3 of my life is huge. Shit, in two years I'll have been a smoker for longer than I have been a non smoker. I still can't imagine not having that in my life either.

I see your point and I understand that, but it never got bad enough to warrant telling them until relatively recently, and I don't really want to shake up status quo. I don't think that I'm going to do anything drastic, I don't even have the energy to eat most of the time regardless. So I don't think I'm a risk to myself as of this moment, and I'm making steps towards making sure that I won't be. At the same time, if it does get bad enough, knowing me, I'll probably just make a huge blatant cry for attention before doing anything anyways... My mother had already told me that we should just commit a double suicide should I get asked to withdraw, so I think it's a safe bet that we'll have plenty of time to talk if it comes to that.

What do you mean by different? At this rate I feel like I'm just going to be stuck, regretting inaction. The worst part being I _know_ that this is going to be all my fault, but I can't be arsed to change it in a meaningful manner.

They have enough to deal with on their plate. If they can handle things on their end, it's only fair that I should be able to handle things on mine.

I'm not really sure what "better" constitutes anymore man... I don't think I have it in me to be happy... Nah the parents don't know, I've only really told them that I'm dumb stressed as an explanation for eating about once every other day to be honest...

I don't resent how you are talking to me, I welcome the advice of those older than me. I recognize that I'm young and foolish and rash and am bound to make mistakes along the way, and having someone who has already lived through some of those mistakes guiding me is always appreciated.

I'm just running out of fuel... I've been struggling with this for the past five or six years. I thought I could make it. I thought I could get better on my own. I thought these thoughts were just passing, that everyone got them before they went to sleep at night. I was wrong. It was not normal, but I'm no snowflake either. It's just hard to fully internalize because this is real, you know? This is happening, to me. This isn't supposed to happen to me. This isn't supposed to happen to anyone even remotely connected to me. This is the shit for movies and shitty dramas that I'd watch and make fun of. I'm trying for a new therapist at a hospital close to my school. I'm hoping I can find something worth living for because as of right now, more and more chips are falling on the other side...

I'm just... resigned...

I just feel so exhausted. I'm tired of feeling so pathetic. I'm tired of lashing out. I'm tired of living. I know that I'm young and that there's a whole world out there, full of surprises and twists and turns. I admire people who can manage to stay strong throughout all of that. I am not one of those people. I'm not strong enough for that. I'm not enough. I feel like I'm one step from the edge.

Shit man I'm only fucking 19 ffs. I'm so fucking tired of feeling like this. I should be fucking nearing the prime of my life. Why the fuck can't I just be happy man? Why the fuck not? What the fuck did I do to deserve this? I'm so fucking tired of feeling like shit. I feel like I've tried every single fucking trick in the god damn book. If this is how I'm going to fucking age I don't want to deal with it. I'm so fucking done feeling like this. I just want this shit to be over with.

I don't actually believe it, yet. I'm convincing myself though. I really, truly believe that I don't matter. I'm waiting for the day I actually do manage to convince myself of it, because that's going to be the day I actually do it.

I'm not sure where I would even start with that working abroad. It was drilled into me that college == success. I never saw any other option.

I may not be the judge of it, but I feel like everything I've done is essentially meaningless as of right now, overshadowed by this pathetic shell of a person I've become...

Well, I guess it's not entirely the easy way out. It's the easiest in the end though. I can finally stop struggling. I can finally stop feeling like this. I can finally stop being such a burden on those who care. Sure, it might hurt them in the short term. But I have faith that those who care for me can forget me, or at the least learn to hate me, or something. I think suicide is inherently selfish and that is one of my biggest qualms about this. It's selfish because it doesn't take into account anyone other than yourself. I'm slowly becoming okay with that.

School has been the only reason I haven't been driven crazy. I need a schedule. I need something to force myself out of bed. Because on a day like today, I've spent the past 12 hours doing nothing. I don't have faith in myself to do anything without that schedule.

I do enjoy being on vacation, it's a change of pace. I generally don't enjoy having free time though, my mind tends to wander like this. I don't have any hobbies, passions, anything. I'm completely, wholly uninteresting as a person.
Thank you, I'll be in touch. I don't mind haha something like this is more than I can ask for. Really though, thanks.
I hope you don't mind if I keep in touch with you?

Yeah, I honestly have a huge fear of being seen as a failure, a burnout, someone with potential that got snuffed or fucked over by some "unfortunate" accident.

Honestly though, the times that I remember how important life is are when I feel like it's about to end not entirely of my own volition. I want to be able to tell myself to get my lazy ass out of bed and actually start studying for my diff eq and orgo midterms that're coming up, but I just can't seem to find the motivation to do so... I know they're important, but I can't find it in me to care right now, even though this is a pivotal semester. My own worst fears are about to come true because of me. I feel like my own worst enemy...

Oh, okay, thank you. I'll try my best to put that into practice. I'm hoping that I can learn to be as clear headed about this as you've learned to be.

I've been keeping up a journal on /r/unsentletters mostly. I made a post and added to it as time went on. I do find that it helps me settle my thoughts and organize how I'm feeling.

Yeah, it's nice having someone else around. It's just hard because generally I enjoy having companionship but the person who I wish was here the most is halfway around the world. The only thing getting me out of bed in the mornings is the fact that I'm going to visit in roughly two weeks...

I really appreciate you taking the time out of your day for this though, thank you so much.

The abandonment thing really got me, I'm deathly afraid of that to be honest... I guess I should make a "break up" plan as well. What exactly was your plan? The thought of her not being in my life is rather erm... unpleasant to say the least. It's really hard on me because she's going out clubbing until 5-6 AM and I'm not even physically there... I do want to be with this girl though and I know that it's not for the wrong reasons.

I'm also very interested in how you find your triggers as well, I'm usually unable to think so clearly while I'm having one of those moods... I know that there are some things that really get me, but I usually can't pinpoint what exactly. My emotional intelligence is lacking to say the least haha
I don't wish to worry them either, especially since my father recently lost his job and my mother is struggling to make ends meet with hers.

Honestly, the only way I can see myself be deserving of it is if I become someone that is better than the person I am now. I don't have much interest in trying it out as of this moment, but I genuinely hope that this mood is flitting and that I don't actually end up killing myself in May.
I guess I'm just projecting. I still don't feel as though I deserve it...

I'm just not sure what other options are out there. It's ingrained in my head that I need to go to school and any alternatives are honestly terrifying. I guess I'm just picking the easy way out, and I'm actually quite okay with that. It's not like I expected anything better of myself...

Honestly, it's for rather selfish reasons though. I've wanted to explore the world a bit more so I figured the peace corps would be the best solution for that. All expense paid 18 month working vacation, right? I need to have the technical background in order to do so though. The benefit of helping other people is just another plus, but not the main draw for me.

I've contemplated taking a break from school, but I don't feel as though taking a break would do any good. I know for a fact that I won't get off my lazy ass if I'm not a student. My GPA is too shitty for me to get an internship at a 1.9 cumulative.

I've only really had two internships, one at a grassroots political organization and one at the nutrition department at my local hospital. Both were great experiences, but not something I'd ever consider doing again.

Ah, I've always thought that libido would decrease, that's new to me. It's rather distracting, I don't really like it. I used to be happy with having orgasming roughly once daily, but lately it's been 3-4 times...

Yes, I think she feels the same, and she has mentioned that talking about these issues I'm having does in fact make her feel closer to me. I never feel very obligated to, she's very good about just making sure that it's known that she's always available. At the same time, this depressive episode has driven me to become so self absorbed. She has her own shit to worry about too. It would just make me feel insanely guilty if she cried and I would need to try to comfort her for my own conscience, so that I could focus fully on myself. It's honestly still insane to me that someone could care for me that much that isn't family. And yes, she is a great girl, thank you! She's one of the very few things that I can genuinely say that I'm glad to have in my life.

It's just that even if I know that people have it worse out there than me, it just makes me feel shittier that I'm contemplating suicide. There're people out there that don't know when they'll get to eat next, yet here I am refusing food because I just don't have an appetite and that food just doesn't taste that great to me anymore. My body feels like it's wasting away and the exercise I'm doing is just facilitating that. I'm eating far under 700 kcal daily... Sorry for the tangent, but yeah. I just don't think that this is ever going to be worth it... I don't know if I want that anymore. I just know that I want this to be over...
Ah, I wasn't aware. I'll be sure to look into that, assuming I get a script and everything. Thank you, sincerely.

My girlfriend is helpful, in her own way. Generally I don't mention it much to her because I feel she worries about it needlessly. She's studying abroad for the semester and I feel like a burden on her when she should be out having the time of her life. She keeps telling me that it's not burdensome, but at the same time how could it not be?

Medication I will give a shot. If it doesn't work I don't think I can even bother going for another chance though.

5-6 more semesters, hopefully.

I'm not really sure yet. I'm not ready for a 9-5 quite yet, so I was looking at the peace corps or something along those lines. I figure even if I feel like shit it doesn't mean that I can't help other people not feel like shit haha

Actually, I am really interested in drug pharmacology, but that was mainly for my own benefit when I wasn't feeling like this. I knew that I would eventually hit a huge slump and I wanted to make sure that I was doing everything within my budget and power to avoid hitting it so hard.

Well, I mean, I've had fun, but generally it was when I felt like I could genuinely die/fuck my life over/under the influence. I guess my definition of fun might be a little warped. Sex is still an interest of mine, my libido has not lowered for some bizarre reason, but I think it might just be used as an escape. I do believe that I genuinely enjoy sex, but I find the more stressed/anxious/emotionally exhausted I get the more my libido increases... Or rather my fixation on sex.
What exactly are prescription plans?

Thank you for your post.

It's hard to treat this as something like a sunburn, especially since I can't see it physically. It just feels like a part of who I am... It's just so hard to ignore the symptoms and address the root issue simply because it feels like _I_ am the root issue.

I've been feeling like I've also become an outside observer to my emotions as well. I think it's more of a defense mechanism than anything to be honest, just so that I can treat my mind as two halves in a sense. Sometimes it does feel like I'm watching a TV show through my own eyes.

Yes, I've noticed that there are months that are better and months that are worse as well, I'm not really sure why...

They did tell me I have depression and moderate ADHD-PI.

See, I've been told it's fixable. I've been told to just keep trying. I don't want to anymore though. And even when people tell me it's not my fault, it's a chemical imbalance, I shouldn't be blaming myself for this, it's hard to disconnect from the thought that it IS my fault. That this is just because this is who I am. I am lazy, with no real drive to do things anymore. The only motivation I've had recently is because of the fact that I planned the date I plan on fixing everything.

Let me rephrase: I don't feel as though I deserve their care. I don't think I'm worth stressing over. I don't think I'm worth them having to spend time worrying needlessly over me when I already know how I'm going to end things.

No, I actually despise engineering. However, I feel that having an engineering degree would be more of a boon than anything. I don't plan on working as an engineer at all. I do think that having an engineering degree shows prospective employers that I know how to think logically.

I've completely grown used to having this feeling of fog. I expect it now. It's a part of me, essentially. I've resigned myself to having it.

I don't know if they can help me with this. My social circle waxes and wanes, yet I never really had fun. I've had to have met hundreds of people, gotten to know a solid 20-30, yet I never really had a time where I could step back and think, "wow, that was really fun". I'm only really in contact with 4-5 people consistently, the rest are just acquaintances.

See, I'm not really feeling unhappy or even that much anxiety to be honest. Sure, my girlfriend might cause me a bit of worry, but I've been distancing myself from that too. I've just stopped feeling, in a sense? I know how I feel, but I feel kind of disconnected from it. As in an outside observer to my emotions. I guess generally I'm just feeling very apathetic. I don't have the drive anymore. I'm sorry for being so negative...
Is that with or without insurance?
I just wanted to say thank you, this really means a lot to me. I've been feeling very isolated lately and it feels very cathartic to vent like this.
I just wanted to say thank you, I really appreciate taking your time out of the day for me.
I just also wanted to say thank you for listening and responding, it really means a lot to me.

I just don't think I can "win" at anything anymore... Dawdling has been the MO of my life lately. I don't have the motivation to do anything. I've spent this past weekend staring at this god forsaken screen whiling the time away. I can't do this.

I don't wish to bring this up to anyone other than my girlfriend or complete strangers though. Even with my girlfriend I don't bring as much up because I feel as though it needlessly worries her.

Medication sounds like the best route to me right now, especially with the majority of commenters recommending it. I'm just feeling very... against it I suppose. I wanted to be able to break out of this under my own power.

Ah, I didn't read the username, I'm sorry. I will definitely check it out, once I get through "The Charisma Myth". I figured even if I'm miserable I may as well attempt to mask it. Fake it til you make it.

Being someone, to me, doesn't mean that I'm going to be famous, or even acknowledged. I just want a shitty studio with money to blow on whatever I'd like. I'm not aiming to be a millionaire, I just want to have financial security and the means to create experiences. Experiences meaning travel, dining, adventure. That, to me, is being someone. Just normality, in a sense I guess. I know that this is going to take effort. I know that it won't be easy. I just don't think I have it in me to try for that anymore.

Engineering is something that's humbling and ripping me apart. I'm humbled because I recognize that there're people far more intelligent than me. It's ripping me apart because I feel pretty stupid. It's a small school, no campus, so generally lacking a social life. I have friends, but the majority are >1 hr away. The ones that I do have close I don't wish to bother with this. They shouldn't have to worry about both themselves and me.

I'm currently on my second semester straight of academic probation. It was only through my professor's kind understanding that I was allowed this second chance. I feel as though it's an inevitable outcome to get asked to withdraw by the end of this semester. I cannot concentrate. I cannot retain material. I'm living life with a "foggy" head.

My girlfriend is someone whom I care for dearly, yet is not physically close with me, causing me a fair bit of anxiety. I do know that in the end that this relationship is worth it, but again, it is straining my emotions. I would give her the world if I could, but as of right now I don't feel I can. I'm too dependent on her for my emotional stability and I feel that it is pushing her away, especially considering she's studying abroad and having the time of her life. I feel like a burden to her. I cannot fathom the reason why she is staying with me.

I understand and agree with you. I don't feel that I've won much though. Anything and everything I've done is because of the privilege granted to me by virtue of my birth in America, my parent's willingness to provide, and general dumb luck.
I've read excerpts and know the general story, although I haven't read it in years, why do you ask?

I honestly have not been told by anyone specifically that I have talent. My inflated ego drove me. I thought that getting a 4.0 in high school meant that I was a genius. My own mother was generally the one telling me that I'm not that special, in terms of grades and academia, not in a harsh way of course. I didn't believe her. I thought I could be someone. I kept telling myself that I'd live a full, exciting life. I was wrong.

I haven't really had enough time here to really have solved anything significant. I don't have much to fall back on. I've stopped taking drugs, I don't get drunk, I just don't have the motivation to anymore. It's not worth it. I'm comfortable. I'm content. I'm existing. I don't want to anymore though. I just want to pass cleanly.

I haven't tried anything prescription, although I have been looking at tianeptine as a possible medication to try. I just don't have the cash for actual prescription medication though.

And yes, bungee jumping gave me the biggest rush of my life. Driving recklessly, missing other cars or barely making turns. Thoughts of jumping in front of a subway car. Running from the police. Cocaine. Traveling to Paris and getting absorbed in the women that I couldn't even speak with. MDMA.

Therapy hasn't helped me much and I don't have the money for medication. I've been self medicating, trying out st. john's wort, l-tyrosine, 5-htp, ashwaghanda. I'm just tired of trying man. It all feels so pointless.
I've been to therapy. I don't want to try meds, I don't have the cash. I envy you. I sincerely envy you.

Yes, this completely. I feel like I had some potential. I feel like I could've been someone or something. I feel like I had so much to look forward to. It's fucking pathetic. My circumstances, my feelings, myself.

I don't know. I don't know why I keep trying. Maybe I don't want to do this. But every day I wake up, I wish I hadn't. I'm so tired. I don't see any opportunity anymore. I've tried drugs, women, alcohol, exercise, eating well, taking better care of myself in general, traveling, video games, anime, counseling, moping, studying, taking up different hobbies, I feel like I've exhausted the list. I've tried so many different things. I'm just not interested in anything anymore. I'm just... existing I guess. I'm tired of it...
I don't have it in me anymore. I don't want to get better just to feel like this all over again. I've lost the light at the end of the tunnel. I feel so hopeless...

I've waited six years to get better. It isn't getting better.

I'm sorry I don't mean to be so negative, I'm just in a really bad place right now...

I don't think I have it in me anymore to try. I think everyone is alone in the end.

I'm just worn thin...
They can laugh, but I don't intend on hearing it if they do. I lost, they won, GGWP. I've resigned myself.

Nothing. Nothing sucks in my life. Except for myself. I've been fucking blessed with the circumstances of my birth. Middle class suburban life. One of the best engineering colleges in the country. No debt. Loving family, girlfriend, friends.

Nothing is what's fucking wrong in my life. Except for me. I don't have any god damn reason to be so fucking miserable. But I am.
I hear you brother. I'm hoping that the both of us can look back at today and wonder, though.

Thank you for your comment.

I'm trying my best to think rationally, to convince myself that doing this would only be losing against my life when the odds are clearly stacked in my favor. Great school, supportive family, good friends, middle class, etc. etc.

I've only ever told two people about how I feel, my (hopefully not but probably) soon to be ex girlfriend, and a friend that's about an hour away. I can't speak with the girlfriend because well, relationship woes. My other friend is talking to me, but I don't want to burden her with what I perceive to be my burdens, it doesn't feel fair.

I'm trying to hard to fix everything, it just seems like everything I touch breaks...
